_about: Broadsheet: a talking head cut like a newspaper coming alive. Fast punch-ins every ~1.6 s across three framings, a newsprint page every 6-8 s (heavy display headline, a brand-colour kicker, an italic deck, the engraving printed like a news photo) slapped in from the right and whipped out, captions as white serif on black paper strips each tilted like a pasted clipping, a byline name tag, a warm punchy newsprint grade, a groovy bed. Built on the same engine as Editorial Collage.

director.style: Broadsheet: a fast, punchy newsroom energy. The speaker is cut often; newsprint pages break in often.
director.hook: The FIRST page lands 1.5-3 s in on the hook's key phrase. Name tag (byline) from the first frame until that page.
director.pages: One page every 6-8 s, 1.2-1.8 s each (short and frequent), never back to back. Each page: a kicker (2-3 words, the topic), ONE headline (the key phrase, 1-4 words), optionally an italic deck (the rest of the line), and one engraving that says what the idea IS.
director.page_lines: Headline = the words being said as the page lands. Every line is spoken WHILE the page is up.
director.slam: Once per video: a slam on the most charged word.
